title: 接地：看不见的保护线（国内版）
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/25_Earthing & Grounding Explained Earth Pit Inspection & Safety Officer Responsibil.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/25_Earthing & Grounding Explained Earth Pit Inspection & Safety Officer Responsibil（国内版）/src.py

points.K6: 名称各国不同，按标准执行
points.S2: 防雷装置也要定期检测

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼外墙边，墙角有一个带盖的接地检查井
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands by the outer wall of a lab building next to a small covered ground inspection pit and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲接地，一条看不见的保护线。

shots.scene: 仪器外壳、绿黄线、大地三个图标连成一条线
shots.prompt_en: Three icons linked in a line: an instrument case, a green and yellow wire, and the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 它把设备和大地连在一起。

shots.scene: 阿杰嫌三孔插头插不进旧插线板，想把接地脚掰掉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tries to bend off the ground pin of a three-pin plug because it does not fit an old two-hole power strip.
shots.narration: 阿杰的插头插不进，想掰掉接地脚。

shots.scene: 小研赶紧拦住，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student quickly stops him and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：那根脚是保命的。

shots.scene: 阿杰一脸疑惑看着插头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at the plug with a puzzled face.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：不接地，不也照样能用？

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 平时能用，出故障时就要命了。

shots.scene: 白板上六个问号气泡
shots.prompt_en: Six question mark bubbles on a whiteboard, each with a small icon: a ground symbol, a transformer, three rods, a shield, a magnifying glass and a balance. No people.
shots.narration: 什么是接地、有几种、为何重要，

shots.scene: 放大镜和天平气泡亮起
shots.prompt_en: The magnifying glass and balance bubbles light up. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么检查，两种接地有何区别。

shots.scene: 电机金属外壳上接着一根黄绿线，通向埋在地下的金属棒
shots.prompt_en: The metal case of an electric motor connected by a green and yellow wire to a metal rod buried in the soil. No people.
shots.narration: 把设备外露的金属外壳和大地相连，

shots.scene: 外壳和大地之间的连线发光
shots.prompt_en: The connection between the metal case and the ground glows softly. No people.
shots.narration: 这就叫保护接地。

shots.scene: 电机内部绝缘破损，火花碰到外壳，外壳带电
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of the motor: damaged internal insulation lets a spark touch the metal case, which glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 设备内部出故障，外壳带了电，

shots.scene: 故障电流沿黄绿线流入大地
shots.prompt_en: A fault current arrow flows from the case down the green and yellow wire into the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 电流顺着低电阻的接地线流入大地。

shots.scene: 配电箱里的保护开关跳下
shots.prompt_en: In a distribution box, a protective breaker lever drops to off. No people.
shots.narration: 还能让保护开关动作，切断故障。

shots.scene: 一台电焊机，内部绝缘破损的示意
shots.prompt_en: A welding machine with a cutaway showing a damaged internal insulation and a red glowing case. No people.
shots.narration: 比如电焊机内部绝缘坏了，外壳带电。

shots.scene: 接地良好，故障电流沿接地通路流走，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: With a good ground wire, the fault current flows safely along the ground path, green check. No people.
shots.narration: 接地良好，故障电流就有安全通路。

shots.scene: 老李碰到机壳，盾牌护住他
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer touches the welding machine case while a protective shield icon surrounds his hand.
shots.narration: 人碰到机壳，触电风险大大降低。

shots.scene: 变压器中性点连着大地
shots.prompt_en: A transformer icon with its neutral point connected by a wire to the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 把电气系统和大地参考相连，

shots.scene: 左边设备接地，右边系统接地，两个框
shots.prompt_en: Two boxes: on the left a motor case connected to ground, on the right a transformer neutral connected to ground. No people.
shots.narration: 外壳接地是设备接地，系统接地是系统的。

shots.section_title: 名称各国不同，按标准执行
shots.scene: 地球图标和几本空白标准手册
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon next to several blank standards books with different colored covers. No people.
shots.narration: 各国、各标准，叫法不太一样。
overlay: 名称各国不同，按标准执行

shots.section_title: 名称各国不同，按标准执行
shots.scene: 老李翻开空白标准手册对照
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens a blank standards book and compares it with a blank drawing.
shots.narration: 实际工作，按国家标准和设计执行。

shots.scene: 三个剖面图并排：埋入地下的管、板、棒
shots.prompt_en: Three soil cross-sections side by side: a vertical metal pipe, a flat metal plate and a metal rod buried in the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 常见的接地极有三种。

shots.scene: 管式剖面放大
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the cross-section with a metal pipe electrode buried in soil and a wire clamp on top. No people.
shots.narration: 管式：把金属管埋进地下。

shots.scene: 板式剖面放大
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the cross-section with a flat copper colored plate buried deep in soil. No people.
shots.narration: 板式：埋一块铜板或镀锌钢板。

shots.scene: 棒式剖面放大
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the cross-section with a long conductive rod driven into soil. No people.
shots.narration: 棒式：把导电棒打进土里。

shots.scene: 土壤、图纸、标准手册三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a soil sample jar, a blank design drawing and a blank standards book. No people.
shots.narration: 用哪种，看土壤、设计和要求，

shots.scene: 老李和王老师看图纸
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the safety administrator review a blank design drawing together.
shots.narration: 由专业人员按标准确定。

shots.scene: 触电、火灾、设备损坏三个图标被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: Three icons blocked by a big shield: a shock symbol, a flame and a broken instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 接地减少触电、电气火灾和设备损坏。

shots.scene: 配电柜外壳带电，接地线断开，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A distribution cabinet with a glowing live enclosure and a broken ground wire, red X. No people.
shots.narration: 配电柜外壳带电，如果接地断了，

shots.scene: 接地和连接线完好，故障电流流走，开关跳闸
shots.prompt_en: With intact ground and bonding wires, the fault current flows away and the breaker trips off, green check. No people.
shots.narration: 接地完好，故障电流有路走，开关跳闸。

shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地指着接地符号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points seriously at a large ground symbol.
shots.narration: 所以接地，绝不能忽视。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表走向接地检查井
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks toward the ground inspection pit holding a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 接地怎么查？一步一步来。

shots.scene: 检查井清晰可见，旁边有接地标志
shots.prompt_en: The ground inspection pit is clearly visible and accessible, with a ground symbol sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 先看：位置清楚、有标识、能接近、有保护。

shots.scene: 盖板完好打勾，破裂盖板打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two pit covers side by side: an intact one with a green check, a cracked broken one with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 盖板要完好，不能破损。

shots.scene: 检查井周围积水、地面开挖
shots.prompt_en: Water pooling around the inspection pit and an open excavation nearby, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 再看周边：有没有积水、破坏、开挖。

shots.scene: 老李打开盖板，查看接地线与接地极的连接
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the pit cover and looks at the clamp joining the ground wire to the electrode.
shots.narration: 再看连接：要紧固，不能松动。

shots.scene: 锈蚀严重的接头图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a heavily rusted clamp with a loose wire, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能有严重锈蚀，导线要接对。

shots.scene: 王老师翻看空白测试记录
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank earth resistance test record in a folder.
shots.narration: 还要查接地电阻的测试记录。

shots.scene: 老李用空白仪表测试，仪表旁有校准标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer measures with a blank test meter that has a calibration sticker.
shots.narration: 由合格电工，用校准过的仪器测。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标打问号，仪表图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon with a question mark next to a test meter icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 光看外观，判断不了接地好不好。

shots.scene: 测试结果和空白标准手册对照
shots.prompt_en: A blank test report placed next to a blank standards book with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 结果要按标准和设计要求核对。

shots.scene: 检查中发现接头松动、锈蚀
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a loose, rusted clamp found during the inspection, with a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 发现接头松动、锈蚀，怎么办？

shots.scene: 王老师在检查表上记录，打电话
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes the defect on the blank checklist and makes a phone call.
shots.narration: 不忽视，记下来，通知电工整改。

shots.scene: 老李换上新接头，王老师复查打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer replaces the clamp; the safety administrator rechecks and ticks the checklist.
shots.narration: 修好后，再复查确认。

shots.scene: 五个打勾的格子
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with five boxes being ticked one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 检查人员要做到五点：

shots.scene: 循环箭头：发现—报告—整改—复查
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow loop with four icons: magnifying glass, telephone, wrench and check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 整改要闭环，复查后才算完。

shots.scene: 临时配电箱、发电机、电焊机、电动工具图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a temporary distribution box, a portable generator, a welding machine and a power drill. No people.
shots.narration: 临时配电箱、发电机、电焊机、电动工具，

shots.scene: 实验楼配电箱和金属外壳仪器
shots.prompt_en: A lab building distribution box and several metal-cased lab instruments like an oven and a centrifuge. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里的配电箱和金属外壳仪器，

shots.scene: 接地符号逐一出现在这些设备旁
shots.prompt_en: A ground symbol appears beside each of these devices one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 都要特别留意接地。

shots.scene: 老李在警戒线内测试，王老师在线外记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests equipment inside a marked area while the safety administrator takes notes outside the line.
shots.narration: 检查人员不亲自维修和测试。

shots.scene: 老李手持空白操作证
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up a blank work permit card.
shots.narration: 交给有资质的电工来做。

shots.scene: 放大镜、核对、电话、跟进四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a magnifying glass, a check mark, a telephone and a calendar with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 检查、核实、报告、跟进，才是本职。

shots.scene: 左框：外壳接地，人旁有盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Left box: a motor case connected to ground, a person pictogram nearby protected by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 保护接地：连外壳，漏电时防触电。

shots.scene: 右框：系统中性点接地，故障电流入地，系统稳定
shots.prompt_en: Right box: a transformer neutral connected to ground, a fault current flowing safely into the earth and a steady gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 系统接地：连系统，让故障电流安全入地。

shots.scene: 检查表上连接、设备、检查井、记录、整改五项
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with five icons: a clamp, an instrument, a pit cover, a record folder and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 不光看检查井，还要看连接、设备和记录。

shots.scene: 小火花图标长成大警示
shots.prompt_en: A tiny spark icon growing into a large warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 用电的小疏忽，会变成大事故。

shots.scene: 地线接到燃气管、暖气管、水管的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a ground wire clamped to a gas pipe, a radiator pipe and a water pipe, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 燃气管、暖气管、水管，不能当地线。

shots.scene: 燃气管旁出现火花和火焰警示
shots.prompt_en: A gas pipe with a small spark and a flame warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 电流走管道，可能引起火灾或触电。

shots.scene: 仪器三孔插头插进三孔插座，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument three-pin plug inserted into a properly grounded three-hole socket, green check. No people.
shots.narration: 接地，要用规范的接地线路。

shots.section_title: 防雷装置也要定期检测
shots.scene: 实验楼屋顶的避雷针和引下线
shots.prompt_en: A lightning rod on the roof of a lab building with a down conductor running to the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 楼顶的避雷装置，也靠接地。
overlay: 防雷装置也要定期检测

shots.section_title: 防雷装置也要定期检测
shots.scene: 日历图标和检测仪表，空白检测报告
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon, a test meter and a blank inspection report. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定定期检测，留好报告。

shots.section_title: 防雷装置也要定期检测
shots.scene: 锈断的引下线，旁边电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A rusted broken down conductor on a wall with a telephone icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 发现引下线锈断，及时报告。

shots.scene: 精密仪器背后接着一根单独的接地线
shots.prompt_en: A precision lab instrument with a separate green and yellow ground wire attached to a ground terminal on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 有的仪器有专门的接地线。

shots.scene: 学生拧下接地线、掰掉接地脚两个图标，都打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons each crossed out with a red X: a hand unscrewing a ground wire from an instrument, and a hand breaking off a plug's ground pin. No people.
shots.narration: 不拆接地线，不掰接地脚。

shots.scene: 阿杰把插线板换成带三孔的合格插线板
shots.prompt_en: The young male student replaces the old two-hole strip with a certified power strip that has three-hole sockets.
shots.narration: 插不进，就换合格的三孔插座。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现外壳接地图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating icon of an instrument case connected to ground.
shots.narration: 保护接地，给故障电流一条安全路。

shots.scene: 管、板、棒三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pipe electrode, a plate electrode and a rod electrode. No people.
shots.narration: 管式、板式、棒式，按标准选。

shots.scene: 盖板、积水、接头、测试记录四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pit cover, a water puddle, a clamp and a test record. No people.
shots.narration: 看外观、看周边、看连接、查记录。

shots.scene: 电话、扳手、勾的循环图标
shots.prompt_en: A loop of icons: a telephone, a wrench and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 发现问题报告，电工整改，复查闭环。

shots.scene: 管道打叉、避雷针、三孔插头三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a crossed-out pipe, a lightning rod and a three-pin plug. No people.
shots.narration: 管道不当地线，防雷定期测，接地不私拆。

shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍三孔插头，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats a three-pin plug in a wall socket and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 接地连着平安，下次见！
